text:
sam: Heads-up: dependency scan flagged two CVEs impacting our Go services — CVE-2026-1234 (grpc) and CVE-2026-2345 (golang-jwt). Auto-issue created.

lina: Can you paste the advisories? severity levels?

sec-bot: Scanner summary: CVE-2026-1234 — google.golang.org/grpc: moderate -> exploit via crafted metadata reflection, fixed in v1.56.0. CVE-2026-2345 — github.com/golang-jwt/jwt: high -> signature verification bypass in 3.2.x, fixed in v3.3.0. See https://example.advisories/security-2026

jon: Do we pull these directly or transitive? which services are affected?

sam: Both are direct: gateway and runtime use grpc directly; auth-service imports golang-jwt directly. Plan: pin to patched versions, run unit + integration tests, do staged canary in prod.

mia: Pin proposal (go.mod diff):

```
require (
    google.golang.org/grpc v1.56.0
    github.com/golang-jwt/jwt v3.3.0
)
```

Commands to apply locally:
```
go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.56.0
go get github.com/golang-jwt/jwt@v3.3.0
go test ./... // auth-service
```

lina: Watch for API changes — grpc minor should be safe, jwt bump might have small breaking rename. Need quick compatibility tests and static checks.

jon: I'll run auth-service unit + integration and smoke tests against staging. sam, can you run gateway tests?

sam: Yep. Proposed canary: 5% traffic for 1h, then 25% for 2h if metrics look good. Rollback criteria: auth failure spike >0.5% or error rate > baseline+3σ.

sec-bot: Add deployment audit log entry and ensure KMS keys used for signing remain intact. Note: no key rewrap required but schedule key-rotation after deployment window.

mia: I'll open the PR with the go.mod changes and a SECURITY changelog entry. Will include commit message: "security: pin grpc@v1.56.0 jwt@v3.3.0 - CVE-2026-1234, CVE-2026-2345". Draft PR id: 1879998895 (WIP).

lina: Prioritize auth-service as P1 (because of signature bypass). Gateway P2. Create a short security ticket and link PR.

jon: Quick update: unit tests pass. Integration hit an auth wrapper failure due to small API rename in jwt v3.3. Pushing a tiny wrapper fix to the PR now.

sam: Nice. After merge, I'll schedule the canary tomorrow 11:30 PT. Monitors to add: auth failure rate, 5xx rate, token validation latency, and audit-log gap. If auth failures >0.5% within 15m -> immediate rollback.

mia: PR updated with wrapper fix and CI passing. Adding smoke run docs in PR description.

lina: Good job. After prod canary completes, update the incident ticket with verification steps and close. Also add a short note to the runbook about pinning transitive deps to avoid regressions.

sam: Thanks all — assigning follow-ups: @jon tests, @mia PR + changelog, @sam canary + monitors. I'll post the deployment window in #eng-oncall once scheduled.

mia: :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Security note recorded: mitigation applied = version pin + canary rollouts. Recommend post-deploy audit log export to S3 and retention 90d.
